summary: E2E validation of the redesigned Dashboard (Overview.jsx) + new backend endpoint /api/dashboard/timeseries. 12/12 pytest cases green in /app/backend/tests/test_dashboard_redesign.py. Frontend UI verified with Playwright on Desktop 1920x1080, Tablet 768x1024 and Mobile 390x844 using the FREE user e2e@orcanext.com. All required data-testids present and visible: dashboard-greeting (shows real company name 'Empresa Teste' — no mock/fallback 'por aí'), cta-new-quote (navigates to /dashboard/quotes/new), primary KPIs (kpi-value-approved, kpi-conversion, kpi-approved), secondary KPIs (kpi-total, kpi-waiting, kpi-refused, kpi-sent) — none contain NaN/Infinity/undefined. Period buttons period-7d/30d/3m/all all trigger BOTH GET /api/dashboard/summary?period=... AND GET /api/dashboard/timeseries?period=... (network capture confirmed). Performance-chart renders recharts LineChart with Enviados (black #000) + Aprovados (#00AD02). Conversion-funnel with 5 stages (enviados=4, visualizados=4, aguardando=0, aprovados=0, assinados=0) is monotonic non-increasing. Recent-quotes + recent-see-all present. Quick-actions with all 4 buttons visible. Plan-status shows 'Gratuito' + '5 / 15 orçamentos' + '10 orçamentos restantes' + plan-upgrade-btn — FREE limit correctly 15. No horizontal scroll on mobile (docWidth=winWidth=390) or tablet (768). Conversion rate correctly shows 0% when sent=0 (verified in backend tests for 4 periods).

issues: Recharts logs 6x warning 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' on initial mount before ResponsiveContainer measures. Chart still renders correctly. Non-blocking. Can be silenced by giving the wrapper an explicit min-height (already 256/288px) or by delaying render until size is known.

verification_evidence.period_filter_network: 7d & all: BOTH summary and timeseries requests captured with correct ?period=
verification_evidence.responsive_scroll: mobile 390x844 docWidth=390 winWidth=390 (no horizontal scroll); tablet 768x1024 docWidth=768 winWidth=768

action_items: Optional (non-blocking): eliminate the 6x recharts 'width(-1)/height(-1)' warnings by gating <ResponsiveContainer> render on a mounted flag or setting an explicit width/height on first paint.
critical_code_review_comments: Overview.jsx:148 fallback name is 'por aí' — if company API ever returns null, header becomes 'Olá, por aí 👋'. Confirmed the real path shows the actual company name, so fine, but consider a neutral fallback like the user's own name.

Overview.jsx:157 emptyAll uses `total===0 && recent.length===0`. Because /quotes and /dashboard/summary load independently, in the very first render before the /quotes promise resolves recent.length is 0 while summary may already have total=5 — logic still works because it also requires total===0. Correct.

server.py:874-882 timeseries relies on ISO string prefix ($substrBytes on created_at) — safe only because created_at is stored as ISO string (verified via iso() helper). If any legacy quote has a Date object, aggregation would silently skip it. Consider $dateToString for robustness.

server.py:895-901 the 'day' timeline loops `while cur <= now` — for period=30d this yields up to 31 buckets which matches chart, ok. For 3m it yields 13-14 weekly points, ok. For 'all' with no quotes, single current-month bucket is returned (line 906-907) — chart still renders an 'empty' point, acceptable.
server.py 1911 lines — same recommendation as iter 4 to split into routers; non-blocking.

To re-run backend: `python -m pytest /app/backend/tests/test_dashboard_redesign.py -v -o addopts=''`. e2e user has 5 quotes (4 ENVIADO/VISUALIZADO, 0 APROVADO). Empty state was not visually tested because e2e user has data; backend test test_summary_periods_no_nan[all] indirectly proves NaN safety at 0 sent. If empty-state UI verification is required, create a fresh user and login. FREE limit is enforced from platform_settings.free_limit falling back to FREE_QUOTE_LIMIT=15 (backend/.env).
